segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵבֶר שֶׁיָּצָא מִקְצָתוֹ, חוֹתֵךְ עַד שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ לָעֶצֶם, וְקוֹלֵף עַד שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ לַפֶּרֶק, וְחוֹתֵךְ. וּבַמּוּקְדָּשִׁין — קוֹצֵץ בְּקוֹפִיץ, שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ מִשּׁוּם שְׁבִירַת הָעֶצֶם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «a portion of a limb has gone out» of its permissible boundary, «one must cut» the meat «until one reaches the bone» at the point that separates between the part of the limb that went out of its boundary and the part that did not, «and» then «peel» the meat away from the bone «until one reaches the joint, and cut» off the limb at the joint, as it is prohibited to break the bone itself. «And with regard to» other «offerings, one may chop» off the part that exited «with a hatchet, as it is not subject to» the prohibition of «breaking a bone.»

segments.he: מִן הָאֲגַף וְלִפְנִים — כְּלִפְנִים, מִן הָאֲגַף וּלְחוּץ — כְּלַחוּץ. הַחַלּוֹנוֹת וְעוֹבִי הַחוֹמָה — כְּלִפְנִים.
segments.en: How does one determine the outer boundaries of a particular location? Anything that is located «from the» inside of the «doorway inward is» considered «as though» it is «inside,» and anything that is located «from the doorway outward is» considered «as though» it is «outside. And the windows» in the wall «and the thickness of the wall are» considered «as though» they are «inside,» such that an offering is considered to have exited the premises only if it is taken outside the wall.

moves.summary: rules how to cut off a partly-exited limb, distinguishing the Paschal lamb from other offerings
defines the boundary: doorway inward is inside, outward is outside; windows and wall thickness are inside

positions.claim: a partly-exited limb of the Paschal lamb is cut to the bone, peeled to the joint and severed there; other offerings may be chopped with a hatchet
positions.basis: prohibition of breaking a bone of the Paschal lamb

positions.claim: from the doorway inward is inside, outward is outside; windows and the wall's thickness count as inside
